high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "Athletech News." The post features a promotional advertisement for ZOA Energy, an energy drink brand associated with Dwayne Johnson. The headline reads, "ZOA Energy by Dwayne Johnson Sees Boost in Sales." The main visual elements include: A row of ZOA Energy drink cans in various flavors (pink, blue, green, orange, and black). A box of ZOA Energy drinks with the brand's logo prominently displayed. The text "ZERO SUGAR" and "NATURALLY FLAVOURED ORIGINAL" on the cans.
